title: 第14章 偷灵鼠
content_zh:
“赚灵石的机会？”

    韩榆疑惑。

    李老道骡马似的丑脸凑近，压低了声音：“那些畜生在咱们眼前放肆，白天时候咱们俩不好出手，晚上别人都看不到，咱们还不得宰了它们？”

    “我去坊市那边打听过，这偷灵鼠毕竟不是凡俗的野兽，一只偷灵鼠尸体，能卖两斤灵米呢！咱们每人用血滴子杀几只，到时候去坊市换了灵米甚至是灵石，修炼的机缘就有了。”

    “也正好不让这些畜生祸害咱们的灵田！”

    韩榆听着，顿时恍然。

    这倒是个办法，总不能任由这些畜生毁了青禾灵米，然后他们落到王管事手中受罚。

    两人悄悄进入灵田之中，偷灵鼠们正在灵田内啃咬，吭哧吭哧的细微声音在两人耳中十分响亮。

    尤其破坏的是他们亲手种植的灵米，更是令他们不由地升起一股怒火。

    夜色下，偷灵鼠的眼睛带着荧绿色的光芒，在灵田之中清晰可见。

    白天尚且不惧韩榆、李老道两人，到了晚上就更加不惧。

    李老道口中分配：“咱们田地中共有五只偷灵鼠，今天晚上，我能用三次血滴子，你应该能用一次，运气好打死四只，运气不好可能打死两三只，分两天应该可以……”

    韩榆听着，心下讶然：原来道爷吃了这么多血食，凝出来精血和我相差不多，同样是三颗精血的程度。

    我炼血功修炼进度，已经赶上了道爷？

    “试试一天吧，道爷，我勉强能凝出第二颗血滴子。”韩榆思量一下后，小声说。

    李老道闻言，丑脸疑惑地转过来，略带惊讶：“你这小娃儿，血气还真够多，也不知道你是怎么修炼的。”

    说完这句话后，却也没再深究，李老道悄然凝出血滴子，对准了其中一只偷灵鼠。

    穿金裂石的血滴子顺他心意，潜藏在夜色之中，穿透了一只偷灵鼠的皮毛。

    偷灵鼠的眼睛两点荧光顿时熄灭，一点血腥味缓缓弥散。

    李老道顿时一喜：“两斤灵米！”

    随后嗅了嗅血腥味，忽然吞咽唾沫，喃喃自语：“这血液里面带有灵气，要是拿来做血食……岂不是要胜过凡俗牲畜？”

    “道爷，趁其他老鼠还没察觉，都杀了吧。”韩榆在一旁提醒。
content_en:
"An opportunity to earn spiritual stones?"

Han Yu was confused.

Li Laodao came closer with an ugly face like a mule and lowered his voice: "Those beasts are running wild in front of us. It's hard for us to do anything during the day, and no one else can see them at night. Why don't we kill them?"

"I went to Fangshi to inquire. After all, this spirit-stealing rat is not an ordinary beast. The body of a spirit-stealing rat can be sold for two kilograms of spiritual rice! Let's each kill a few of them with blood drops. When the time comes, we can go to Fangshi to exchange for spiritual rice or even spiritual stones, and we will have the opportunity to practice."

"It's just the right time to prevent these beasts from harming our spiritual field!"

Han Yu suddenly became enlightened when he heard this.

This is a way, we can't let these beasts destroy Qinghe Lingmi, and then they fall into the hands of Manager Wang and be punished.

The two quietly entered the spiritual field. The spirit-stealing rats were gnawing in the spiritual field, and the tiny sounds of chirping were very loud in their ears.

What was particularly damaged was the spiritual rice they planted themselves, which made them even more angry.

Under the night, the spirit-stealing rat's eyes glowed with fluorescent green, clearly visible in the spiritual field.

During the day, I was not afraid of Han Yu and Li Laodao, but I was even less afraid at night.

Li Laodao said: "There are five spirit-stealing rats in our field. Tonight, I can use the blood drop three times, and you should be able to use it once. If you are lucky, you will kill four. If you are unlucky, you may kill two or three. You should be able to spread it over two days..."

Han Yu was surprised when he heard this: It turns out that Master Dao ate so much blood food, and the essence and blood he produced was similar to mine, at the same level as three essence and blood.

I have already caught up with Master Dao in my blood refining skills?

"Try it for a day, Master Tao. I can barely make a second drop of blood." Han Yu whispered after thinking for a moment.

When Li Laodao heard this, his ugly face turned around with confusion, and he was slightly surprised: "You little kid, you really have a lot of blood, I don't know how you practice."

After saying this, without going into further details, Li Laodao quietly condensed blood drops and aimed at one of the spirit-stealing rats.

The droplets of blood that penetrated the cracked gold stone followed his will, hiding in the night, and penetrated the fur of a spirit-stealing rat.

The two fluorescent points in the spirit-stealing rat's eyes suddenly went out, and a hint of blood slowly dispersed.

Li Laodao was immediately delighted: "Two kilograms of spiritual rice!"

Then he sniffed the smell of blood, suddenly swallowed his saliva, and murmured to himself: "This blood contains spiritual energy. If it is used as blood food... wouldn't it be better than ordinary livestock?"

"Master Dao, kill all the other mice before they notice." Han Yu reminded from the side.
